reponse: To enable the new dashboards locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` (with the API running), then hard-reload the page; you can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [2][3]. The old method of setting `FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash` in `.env.local` no longer works, since #447 renamed the flag to `dashboards_v2` and flags are now served by the API instead of the build-time env [2][3]. Note that new workspaces with no events show a blank grid until the empty state ships [5].
